tools.name: notes_search
tools.description: Search the user's CODD notes (Markdown, often in Traditional Chinese / 繁體中文) by words, "quoted phrases" or #tags. Returns titles, codd://note/<id> refs, kinds, update times and snippets. Open a result with notes_read.

query.description: Words to find in titles, bodies and tags; all must match. Chinese terms of any length work. #tag filters by tag, "quoted phrases" keep their spaces.

scope.description: all: every note you may see. project: only notes of the current session's project or linked to the session.

tags.description: Only notes with all of these tags (without #).

tools.name: notes_list
tools.description: List the user's CODD notes, newest first: recent notes, notes linked to the current session or project, pinned notes, prompts. Open a result with notes_read.

session.description: "current" for notes linked to this session, or a CODD session UUID.

project.description: "current" for notes of this session's project, or a project path.

days.description: Only notes updated in the last N days.

tools.name: notes_read
tools.description: Read one CODD note by ref (an id, codd://note/<id> or [[note:<id>]]). Returns its Markdown (often 繁體中文) with absolute file paths, its images as image blocks, and each image's annotations as numbered items in original image pixels (origin top-left). Long notes are paged: call again with the offset it reports.

ref.description: The note: an id (rwd-punch-k7x2), codd://note/<id> or [[note:<id>]].

offset.description: Character offset to start from; use the offset a previous page reported.

max_chars.description: Characters of note text per page.

include_images.description: Attach the note's images (at most 4) as image blocks.

tools.name: notes_append
tools.description: Append a Markdown section to the end of a CODD note whose AI access is APPEND (other notes refuse). The section is marked as written by AI; existing text is never changed. The user may be asked to approve.

ref.description: The note: an id (rwd-punch-k7x2), codd://note/<id> or [[note:<id>]].

markdown.description: The Markdown to append, in the language of the note.

heading.description: Heading of the new section (default: AI 附加 · HH:mm).

tools.name: notes_create
tools.description: Create a NEW note in the user's CODD notebook (INBOX) for the user to read there: a report, plan, review or summary they asked you to put in CODD, instead of a Markdown file in the project. It is linked to this session and its project, its AI access is APPEND (add to it later with notes_append), and it never changes an existing note. Returns the new codd://note/<id> ref and the file path. The user may be asked to approve.

title.description: The note's title, one line without #.

body.description: The note's Markdown, without the title line, in the language the user works in. Longer text: create the note, then add the rest with notes_append.

kind.description: note (the default), or prompt for a prompt the user will send later.

tools.name: notes_write
tools.description: Replace the body (everything after the title line) of a CODD note whose AI access is APPEND. CODD keeps a snapshot of the old text and always asks the user first. Prefer notes_append.

ref.description: The note: an id (rwd-punch-k7x2), codd://note/<id> or [[note:<id>]].

markdown.description: The new body, without the title line (it is kept).
